assertions.source: Finite-difference dα/dq_0 computed at 5 step sizes (1e-10 to 1e-20) at 50 dps; propagation factor compared to 0.31 ppb residual / 22 ppb q_0 uncertainty.

description: Q_0 sensitivity analysis for the empirical form from #1484. Computes dα/dq_0 at q_0 via finite differences (50 dps); tests whether the 22 ppb CAL-2 uncertainty on q_0 (from m_μ/m_e) propagates to ≥0.31 ppb on α_EM, which would mean the residual in #1484 is upstream calibration noise, NOT a missing structural piece.

data.verdict: RESIDUAL EXPLAINED — q_0 uncertainty propagates to ≥0.31 ppb on α; form IS exact
data.explanation: The 22 ppb CAL-2 uncertainty on q_0 propagates to 150.335 ppb on α_EM⁻¹, which is >= the observed residual 0.31 ppb. This means the empirical form α_EM⁻¹ = T + α·H·(1-h²α) IS EXACT within precision, and the apparent 0.31 ppb residual is upstream calibration noise from CAL-2.
